$description: Lookup-View die fuer jede Maschine den machine_type und ihre process_table liefert. Full text: docs/history/standard/historians/views/machine_index.md, $description.
definition: SELECT DISTINCT machine_id, 'CNC'::text AS machine_type, 'cnc_process_data'::text AS process_table FROM cnc_process_data UNION SELECT DISTINCT machine_id, 'SGM'::text, 'injection_molding_data'::text FROM injection_molding_data
